verdict: Meta is delivering; Google's conversion tracking needs immediate resolution.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 36 leads at an average cost per lead of $103.54, with all 36 attributed to Meta — a positive sign for that channel, and cost per lead improved 24% in the most recent 7 days. Google Ads, however, recorded only 3 conversions on $1,891.59 in spend this period, and recent daily data shows near-zero spend alongside zero leads, which points to a tracking or budget issue rather than campaign performance. We are actively reviewing Google's conversion tracking and bid setup to determine whether leads are being missed or spend is being throttled incorrectly. Separately, your intake pipeline shows 104 new opportunities logged this period with no appointments confirmed, which we are flagging as a follow-up process gap to address alongside the media work. Expect a clearer Google picture and intake process recommendations in next week's report.
